items.text: Do the best you can until you know better. Then when you know better, do better.
We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
Little by little, a little becomes a lot.
items.attribution: proverb (often attributed to Tanzanian or African origin)

items.text: If you can do it, you can do it again.
Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
What lies behind us and what lies before us are tiny matters compared to what lies within us.
Do not wait for leaders; do it alone, person to person.
Whether you think you can or you think you can’t, you’re right.
Act as if what you do makes a difference. It does.
He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.
The best way out is always through.
In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.
You miss 100% of the shots you don’t take.
What we fear doing most is usually what we most need to do.
Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
Not everything that is faced can be changed, but nothing can be changed until it is faced.
Between stimulus and response there is a space. In that space is our power to choose our response.
Make your life a masterpiece; imagine no limitations on what you can be, have, or do.
What you get by achieving your goals is not as important as what you become by achieving your goals.
The future depends on what you do today.
If there is no struggle, there is no progress.
Be yourself; everyone else is already taken.
